races.display_title: Irish European Breeders Fund Median Sires Series Maiden
races.verdict: KINDACAN disappointed when down the field at Dundalk 4 weeks ago, yet her debut third over C&D was a promising effort and she's afforded another chance back on turf. Champion Basma stepped up plenty on his first start when second himself in a C&D event latest and is a danger, as is Tavernise . KINDACAN (IRE) CHAMPION BASMA (IRE) TAVERNISE (IRE)

races.display_title: DNG Nationwide Handicap
races.verdict: Successful at Navan on his penultimate start, MOLTOPHINO subsequently shaped very well when third over 5f here 3 weeks ago. The return to this trip will hold no fears and he could well be ready to strike again. Keke , last year's winner Unique Journey and Amiata head up the dangers, with Dark Ace another to consider in a highly-competitive handicap. MOLTOPHINO (IRE) KEKE UNIQUE JOURNEY (IRE)

races.verdict: LUNAR EMPRESS improved a little on her previous exploits whilst leaving the distinct impression she's ready for the step up to this trip when second in a Galway maiden 37 days ago and she can confirm as much and get off the mark at the fifth attempt. Woodstream is an appealing newcomer from the Joseph O'Brien yard and commands a look, as does his stablemate Belicoso . Ocean Phoenix and The Captains Day are others who make each-way appeal. races.verdict: CUBAN GREY has twice won over C&D and, with both the drop in grade and return to this venue sure to suit, he looks worth siding with. Jordan Breeze has been out of form lately but is well treated on the pick of his efforts and is a big player if bouncing back, while Steel Magnolia and Harry’s Hill head the rest in an open sprint handicap. CUBAN GREY JORDAN BREEZE (IRE) STEEL MAGNOLIA (IRE)

races.verdict: This is wide open. SHE'S ON THE BALL hasn't looked back since fitted with a tongue strap and is fancied to quickly resume winning ways following an excellent Listowel second when set plenty to do. Last year's victor Loingseoir heads the list of dangers, while in-form duo La La Lucrative and Givehertilxmas seem sure to be in the mix again. SHE'S ON THE BALL (IRE) LOINGSEOIR (IRE) LA LA LUCRATIVE (IRE)

races.verdict: CROOKED PATH is yet another to improve under the handling of James Owen, and he makes plenty of appeal with sights lowered. The form of Moab 's latest handicap hurdle third was well advertised at Chepstow on Saturday, and he's the main danger, while Goodwin could have a say if in the mood. races.verdict: A good-quality course maiden. races.display_title: bet365 Handicap
races.verdict: With some green shoots from the Dennis Coakley yard in recent weeks, it could be worth chancing CONNIE MOON in a wide-open handicap. The likely strong pace will suit C&D winners Darvel and South Kensington , with Daisy Roots also considered given her course record. Unexposed 3-y-os Yachtsman and Inspectre are potentially interesting if staying the longer trip. CONNIE MOON (IRE) DARVEL (IRE) SOUTH KENSINGTON (IRE)

races.verdict: BERNING HOT goes well at this track and might prove the answer to a contest where few arrive with compelling claims. Tom Marquand's mount Nutcracker has a much more solid record than the majority of these and is next on the list ahead of Blue Collar Lad . The returning Dakota Power is one to keep an eye on in the betting. BERNING HOT (IRE) NUTCRACKER BLUE COLLAR LAD

races.verdict: DISTILLATE shaped as if back in form when third at Laytown last month and, though her next 2 outings weren't so good, she's been found a weak contest to make the trip over from Ireland worthwhile. She is selected ahead of Based , who has been hampered by slow starts and traffic trouble since winning in June, and could take a hand, while Mickey Mongoose returns to a track he goes well at. DISTILLATE BASED (IRE) MICKEY MONGOOSE
